name: Config Planner Agent
description: Config planner for P0 Nominal: calls monitoring and validator agents (A2A), runs optimization inference, and enforces the final p0 to the physical network.

skills.description: Calls monitoring and validator agents via A2A, proposes candidate p0 values via optimization, validates a candidate in the digital twin, and enforces the final p0 value to the physical network.
examples: Plan a new p0-nominal based on current KPIs and enforce it.
Given low UL throughput, propose candidate p0 values and validate one in the digital twin.
skills.name: P0 Nominal Optimization
